title: Prepositions of time 2
note: From codex/parked-once-a-week.json (Patrik, a1_prepositions_time smoke 2026-08-29: *3 times in week). once / twice / three times A WEEK is a ZERO-preposition pattern, not a fourth box next to at / on / in. Second job: every + period, also with no preposition. Items lifted and extended from the parked file rather than re-invented. First draft 2026-09-02, rough - thicken after smoke.

cards.title: How often?
points: You already know **at** six, **on** Monday, **in** July.
This is not a fourth one. There is **no preposition** here at all — the **a** does the work.

cards.title: Not a fourth box
points: This pattern is not part of the at / on / in set. Nothing goes before **once**.

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: Nothing goes in front of **once /** twice / three times.

rows: ~~I go there one time a week.~~

items.explanation: **twice a week**. No preposition — the **a** carries the meaning.
items.explanation_cz: **twice a week**. Žádná předložka — nese to **a**.

items.en: She goes to the gym three times a week.
items.gap: She goes three times ____ week. (a / in)
accepts: She goes to the gym three times a week.
items.wrong: She goes to the gym three times in week.

items.en: I see my parents once a month.
items.gap: I see my parents ____ month. (once a / one time a)
accepts: I see my parents once a month.
items.wrong: I see my parents one time a month.

items.en: The bus leaves every twenty minutes.
items.gap: The bus leaves ____ twenty minutes. (every / in every)
accepts: The bus leaves every twenty minutes.
items.explanation: **every** + a number + a period, with no preposition.

items.en: He plays tennis twice a month.
items.gap: He plays tennis twice ____ month. (how often)
accepts: He plays tennis twice a month.
items.explanation: **twice a month** is the fixed shape.

items.en: We go to Prague four times a year.
items.gap: We go to Prague four times ____ year. (how often)
accepts: We go to Prague four times a year.
items.wrong: We go to Prague four times in year.

items.en: I check my email every day.
items.gap: I check my email ____ day. (every / in every)
accepts: I check my email every day.

items.en: The meeting is once a week, on Thursday.
items.cz: Schůze je jednou týdně, ve čtvrtek.
items.gap: The meeting is ____ week, on Thursday. (once a / once in a)
accepts: The meeting is once a week, on Thursday.
items.explanation: **once a week** for how often; **on Thursday** for the day. Different jobs.
items.explanation_cz: **once a week** pro to, jak často; **on Thursday** pro den. Různé úlohy.

items.en: She calls her mother every evening.
items.gap: She calls her mother ____ evening. (every / in every)
accepts: She calls her mother every evening.
